calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.format, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_ret, count(*) AS nret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT format, count(*) AS lines, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS l999, sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lzz,
 sum(net_amount) AS sold, sum(r.refund_net) AS ref, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > net_amount+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_refund,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.qty_ret > quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_qty, sum(CASE WHEN r.nret>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_ret,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM sold LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.status, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS sold, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders,
  sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds, count(r.sales_line_id) AS lines_with_refund
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=900
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT max(return_date) AS last_return, count(*) AS n,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_returns,

 max(r.return_date - f.sale_date) AS max_lag
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
